_notes: Read from saves/Unmatched Official Tournament Table October 2026 (Hellboy).json (read only): infinite bag 80f94d > bag 69b878. Every GUID comes from that inner bag and is kept when its objects are taken out.

fighters: by HeroDef fighter id (piece = GUID of the miniature or token; a list if the GUID changes when the state changes; dial = life dial; dial_max = MAX_VALUE of its script). Without a dial = 1 HP piece.

deck.card_ids = CardID range of the 30 cards; character_card_id goes inside the same physical deck (31 cards) but outside the range. deck.identity = (FaceURL, BackURL) of the sheet: what identifies the deck (the CardID is not enough).

The Leonardo miniature is nicknamed '[016099]Leonardo' (a TTS colour tag): the importer ignores colour tags when matching names. Leonardo's deck uses the same DeckID 176 as Medusa's, with its own FaceURL: hero detection tells them apart by deck.identity (images), not by the CardID.
